origin.summary: Workout 4 of the 2013 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: A 7-minute ascending-rep couplet of clean and jerks and toes-to-bar, climbing by threes.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2013/4 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09; ascending ladder (+3 reps each round); pattern continues indefinitely until the 7-minute cap
